help.title: Which AI should I use?
help.intro: Both run the <1>same analysis</1> — pick by what matters today. You can switch anytime; only speed and billing change.

api.title: API key
api.body: Reads many scenes in parallel, so a full re-analysis finishes in minutes. Billed per token; rate and credit limits apply.

claude.title: Claude Code
claude.body: Chat, agent tasks, and steady analysis on your existing Claude subscription — no per-token bill. Reads one scene at a time, so big batches take a while.

matter.body: Your pick changes <1>speed and billing, not the result</1> — both run the identical pipeline and write the same data, so switching providers won't rewrite your threads or coherence. The one quality lever is <3>which model reads</3> (a faster model can be a little looser at linking threads), and you can re-analyze on a stronger one anytime.
